description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Printer_HTMLDefinition, responsible for rendering an HTML definition object into an HTML report. The class includes methods to generate detailed tables for doctype information, environment settings, content sets, and element info, including various attributes and children.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_HTMLDefinition
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering detailed HTML definitions for inspection or documentation purposes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method to generate the complete HTML report of the HTML definition based on a given configuration.

methods.name: renderDoctype
methods.description: Renders a table showcasing doctype information, including name, XML compliance, modules, and tidy modules.

methods.name: renderEnvironment
methods.description: Renders environment-related information such as parent fragment, global attributes, tag transforms, and attribute transforms.

methods.name: renderContentSets
methods.description: Generates a table summarizing content sets and their lookups.

methods.name: renderInfo
methods.description: Creates a table listing the allowed HTML elements, their attributes, and child elements.

methods.name: renderChildren
methods.description: Renders a detailed description of permissible child elements for a given element definition.

methods.name: listifyTagLookup
methods.description: Formats a tag lookup array into a sorted list of tags.

methods.name: listifyObjectList
methods.description: Listifies a list of objects, retrieving class names for display.

methods.name: listifyAttr
methods.description: Formats attribute definitions into a list of attribute names with their class types.

methods.name: heavyHeader
methods.description: Creates a styled header row for tables.
